page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 24 vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It features a base CPU clock speed of 3.1 GHz, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is capped at an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results place the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple standardized tests. In CPU-focused workloads, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 9875.0. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 1282.13 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 48.03 GB/sec for large-block writes. For specialized tasks, the server demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec and processed Redis SET operations at 22.14 million operations per second.

Lacking local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, this instance relies entirely on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing. This hardware profile offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose workloads, avoiding the premium costs associated with specialized accelerator hardware or high-density local storage arrays. It is suited for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference, where its 3.1 GHz dedicated Intel cores can be fully utilized without requiring massive memory footprints.
